v1-7-0.title: Online Presentation Timer and French
v1-7-0.summary: A speaking session can now keep one named agenda on a shared clock: the host edits, a colleague can operate from a phone, and the room sees a projector-ready display. ClassroomTimers is also fully localized in French.

items.presentationTimer: Added an Online Presentation Timer with timed agenda items, templates, and shareable room links
items.presentationViews: Added host, operator, and read-only display views that stay on the same end time

v1-6-0.title: Classroom duration pages, Visual Timer, and exam presets
v1-6-0.summary: This release expands quick classroom timing and test-prep workflows with preset duration landing pages, a disc-based visual countdown, and dedicated multi-section exam timer pages with supporting content.

items.visualTimer: Added Visual Timer with a progress disc and classroom-friendly countdown display
items.examPresetTimers: Added dedicated SAT Timer, GRE Timer, and IELTS Timer pages with multi-section presets

v1-5-0.title: Pomodoro Timer and Brazilian Portuguese Support
v1-5-0.summary: This release adds a focused Pomodoro workflow and makes ClassroomTimers available in Brazilian Portuguese.

items.pomodoro: Added a Pomodoro Timer with customizable focus, breaks, and sessions
items.pomodoroFeatures: Added automatic transitions, completion counters, background sounds, and finish alerts

v1-4-0.title: More Backgrounds and Appearance Settings
v1-4-0.summary: Classroom Timer, Flip Clock, and Digital Clock now include additional backgrounds and appearance options.

items.timer: Classroom Timer: added 4 backgrounds and add/subtract time buttons
items.flipClock: Flip Clock: added font settings, hourly chime, and 9 backgrounds
items.digitalClock: Digital Clock: added hourly chime and 9 backgrounds

v1-3-0.title: Fun Timers and Spanish Support
v1-3-0.summary: This release adds a collection of seven animated visual timers and makes ClassroomTimers available in Spanish.

items.funTimers: Added Bomb, Rainbow, Sand, Traffic Light, Candle, Egg, and Popcorn timers
items.funTimerControls: Added shared presets, custom durations, full screen, screen wake lock, and configurable finish sounds to the new timers

v1-2-0.title: Exam Timing and Japanese Support
v1-2-0.summary: This release launches the Exam Timer, adds complete Japanese localization, and improves Flip Clock and Digital Clock layouts on mobile.

items.examTimer: New Exam Timer for SAT, GRE, IELTS, and custom multi-section sessions
items.mobileClocks: Improved Flip Clock and Digital Clock sizing and layout on mobile screens

v1-1-0.title: More Ways to Time Every Round
v1-1-0.summary: This release adds three dedicated interval timing tools and a new quartz-style dial for the stopwatch.

items.interval: Online Interval Timer for custom work and break durations, rounds, presets, and alerts
items.hiit: Online HIIT Timer with workout-focused presets for high-intensity training and recovery
items.tabata: Online Tabata Timer with classic 20-second work and 10-second rest intervals
items.stopwatchDial: Stopwatch now switches between the digital display and a quartz-style analog dial

v1-0-0.title: Initial Release
v1-0-0.summary: The first official release of ClassroomTimers with all core classroom timing tools.

items.timer: Classroom timer with large projector-ready countdown, presets, and a clear finish warning
items.world: Fullscreen world clock with live day-night map and multi-city local times
items.flip: Online flip clock with optional seconds, styles, and backgrounds
items.digital: Online digital clock with optional seconds, date, styles, and backgrounds
items.stopwatch: Online stopwatch with laps, adjustable precision, and wake lock
items.fullscreen: Fullscreen mode and keep-screen-on controls for classroom displays
items.settings: Settings panels for appearance, display, and behavior preferences
items.local: Local preference storage in the browser—no account required
items.responsive: Responsive layout for phones, tablets, desktops, and projectors
items.privacy: Privacy-focused design with minimal data collection

aboutPage.heading: About ClassroomTimers
aboutPage.intro: ClassroomTimers is a free set of browser-based timing tools built for teaching, presenting, and focused learning.

who.heading: Who we are
who.body: We are a small independent team focused on practical classroom productivity tools. We believe simple, well-designed timers and clocks can make everyday teaching clearer without requiring accounts, installs, or complicated setup.

story.heading: Our story
story.p1: ClassroomTimers started with a straightforward need: teachers often want a large, reliable countdown on a projector or spare screen within seconds—without fighting ads, tiny digits, or app downloads.
story.p2: From that classroom timer core we added a world clock for cross-time-zone classes, flip and digital clocks for shared time displays, and a stopwatch for drills and practice—keeping the same calm, readable visual language across tools.

items.classroom: Classroom Timer: large countdown presets, clear finish warning, and projector-friendly display
items.fullscreen: Fullscreen mode: hide chrome so time stays dominant on classroom screens and TVs
items.wake: Keep screen awake: optional wake lock for long lessons and always-on displays
items.world: World Clock: compare cities with map context, offsets, and day-night cues
items.clocks: Flip Clock & Digital Clock: styles, backgrounds, seconds, and date options for desks and boards
items.stopwatch: Stopwatch: lap timing with adjustable precision for drills and study tracking
items.local: No account required: preferences stay in your browser; classroom labels are not uploaded
items.responsive: Works on desktop, tablet, and phone with the same core tools

items.timer: Classroom Timer — free online countdown for lessons, activities, and exams
items.world: World Clock — fullscreen multi-city times with a live day-night map
items.flip: Flip Clock — mechanical-style flip display for shared screens
items.digital: Digital Clock — high-contrast digital time with styles and backgrounds
items.stopwatch: Stopwatch — online stopwatch with laps for classroom and study use

future.heading: Future plans
future.p1: We plan to keep expanding ClassroomTimers for real classrooms. Upcoming directions include:

items.backgrounds: More background options for clocks and timer stages
items.dynamic: Dynamic backgrounds that stay calm enough for teaching screens
items.languages: More languages beyond English and Simplified Chinese
items.whiteboard: Classroom whiteboard tools that work alongside timers and clocks
items.more: Other teaching workflows shaped by teacher feedback

future.p2: If a feature would help your classroom, we want to hear it. Feedback shapes what we build next.

support.heading: Support us

items.share: Share with colleagues: send ClassroomTimers to another teacher who needs a clear classroom screen timer
items.feedback: Leave feedback: tell us what works in real lessons and what is missing

support.closing: Thanks for using ClassroomTimers and helping keep classroom timing simple.

privacyPage.heading: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how ClassroomTimers (“we”, “us”) handles information when you use https://classroomtimers.app. Last updated: July 31, 2026.

summary.heading: Summary
summary.body: ClassroomTimers is designed to run in your browser. Timer settings and display preferences are stored locally on your device. We do not require an account, and we do not upload classroom labels or countdown content to our servers for you to use the tools.

collect.heading: Information we process
collect.p1: Depending on how you use the site, the following may apply:

items.local: Local preferences: style, duration, city selections, and similar settings may be saved in your browser (for example via localStorage) so the tools remember your choices.
items.analytics: Aggregate analytics: we use Vercel Analytics to understand basic traffic patterns (such as page views). This is intended to be privacy-friendly and does not require you to create an account.
items.noAccount: No account profile: we do not ask you to register, and we do not collect classroom roster data as part of the core product.

items.run: To operate and display the timers and clocks in your browser
items.improve: To understand which pages are used and improve reliability and content
items.security: To protect the service against abuse and technical issues

storage.heading: Local storage and control
storage.body: Because preferences live in your browser, you can clear them by clearing site data for classroomtimers.app in your browser settings. Doing so may reset tool appearance and saved choices.

thirdParty.heading: Service providers
thirdParty.body: The website may be hosted and delivered through infrastructure providers such as Vercel. Those providers process technical request data (for example IP address and request metadata) as needed to serve the site securely.

children.heading: Children and classrooms
children.body: ClassroomTimers is intended as a general teaching utility. Do not enter sensitive student personal information into labels or other free-text fields. We do not knowingly collect children’s personal information through account registration because accounts are not required.

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the product evolves. The “Last updated” date at the top will change when we do. Continued use of the site after an update means you accept the revised policy.

contact.heading: Contact

termsPage.heading: Terms of Service
termsPage.intro: These Terms of Service govern your use of ClassroomTimers at https://classroomtimers.app. By using the site, you agree to these terms. Last updated: July 31, 2026.

acceptance.heading: Agreement
acceptance.body: If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use ClassroomTimers. The service is provided as a free web application for classroom and personal timing use.

service.heading: The service
service.body: ClassroomTimers provides browser-based tools such as a classroom countdown timer, world clock, flip clock, digital clock, and stopwatch. Features may change over time as we improve the product.

items.lawful: Use the tools only for lawful purposes and in ways that respect school and workplace policies.
items.noAbuse: Do not attempt to disrupt, scrape abusively, reverse engineer in a harmful way, or overload the service.
items.accuracy: Treat displayed times as convenience utilities. For official competition timing, legal deadlines, medical dosing, or other high-stakes decisions, use certified instruments and procedures.

disclaimer.heading: No warranties
disclaimer.body: ClassroomTimers is provided “as is” and “as available” without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose. Browser behavior, device clocks, network conditions, and hardware can affect display and wake-lock availability.

availability.heading: Availability
availability.body: We aim to keep the site available, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted access. Maintenance, hosting issues, or changes may temporarily limit features.

liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or for lost lessons, lost data, or timing discrepancies arising from your use of the site.
